python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# FY1981 net budget outlays by month (in millions)
fy1981_outlays = [59099, 53969, 54216, 57198, 54608, 55619, 58486, 53095, 53698, 64216, 56838, 76875]

# Calculate population standard deviation
n = len(fy1981_outlays)
mean = sum(fy1981_outlays) / n

# Population standard deviation formula
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in fy1981_outlays) / n
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)

print(f"FY1981 Net Budget Outlays (millions): {fy1981_outlays}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")
print(f"Variance: {variance}")
print(f"Population Standard Deviation: {round(std_dev, 2)}")
EOF
